# Third-Party Asset Licenses

## Fonts

This project uses system fonts and Google Fonts-compatible fallbacks. No external font CDNs are loaded at runtime.

## Code Libraries

All JavaScript/TypeScript dependencies are open source. See `package.json` for full dependency list. Key licenses:

| Package | License |
|---------|---------|
| three | MIT |
| @react-three/fiber | MIT |
| @react-three/drei | MIT |
| @react-three/rapier | MIT |
| @react-three/postprocessing | MIT |
| react | MIT |
| zustand | MIT |
| gsap | Standard GSAP License (free for most uses) |

## 3D Assets

All 3D geometry in this project is procedurally generated using Three.js primitives and custom shader materials. No external 3D model files are used. No CC-BY or ATTRIBUTION required for geometry.

## Textures

All textures are procedurally generated using Three.js `CanvasTexture` and custom noise functions. No external texture files are used.

## Audio

All audio in this project is synthesized using the Web Audio API. No external audio files are included or loaded. No licensing required.

## AI-Assisted Development

This project was developed with AI assistance. The final code is original work intended for open distribution.
